what: local dry run, scale tiny, fakes only; peak resident memory vs the 512 MB free Render instance
command: /usr/bin/time -v python -m distillery --root <tmp> run --pack sql --scale tiny --dry-run (PYTHONPATH=<worktree>/src, Python 3.13)
caveats: measures the pipeline's own memory with fake models (no live openai/httpx connection pools, no real student sandbox client); the live path adds the real clients, whose size was not measured here

server figure is import of create_app only (peak RSS after importing the app module), not a serving process with traffic; the sum is therefore an approximate bound, not a measurement of a running instance
scale tiny only; gated runs hold larger task sets in memory (not measured)
